blocks.prompt: 10 A spacecraft moves from point \((120, 240, -50)\) to point \((130, 210, 80)\) in kilometers. What is the magnitude of the displacement vector in kilometers?
blocks.explanation:
Displacement (jagah ki tabdeeli) woh vector hai jo shuru wale point se aakhri point tak jata hai, chahe raasta kaisa bhi ho.
Diya kya hai? Shuru ka point \((120, 240, -50)\) aur aakhri point \((130, 210, 80)\), km mein.
Find kya karna hai? Displacement vector ki lambai (km mein).
Plan: har coordinate mein "end minus start", phir magnitude formula. Asal mein yeh do points ke darmiyan distance ka formula hi hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: shuru \(P(120, 240, -50)\), aakhir \(Q(130, 210, 80)\), km mein.
Humein find karna hai: \(|\overrightarrow{PQ}|\).
Tareeqa: \(\overrightarrow{PQ}\) = end minus start, phir magnitude. Units km hi rahenge.

Displacement vector
\[\overrightarrow{PQ} = (130 - 120)\underline{i} + (210 - 240)\underline{j}\]
\[\quad + (80 - (-50))\underline{k}\]
\[= 10\underline{i} - 30\underline{j} + 130\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Har coordinate mein aakhri value minus shuru wali value.
Dhyan dein: \(80 - (-50) = 130\) hai, 30 nahi; minus minus plus banta hai.

Simplify karein
\[\sqrt{17900} = \sqrt{100 \times 179}\]
\[= 10\sqrt{179} \approx 133.8\]
Kyun: 17900 mein 100 perfect square factor hai, us ka root 10 bahar aa gaya. 179 prime number hai, is liye aage simplify nahi hota. Taqreeban 133.8 km.

Tasdeeq (andaza)
\[130 < 133.8 < 10 + 30 + 130\]
Kyun: Lambai sab se bare component (130) se kam nahi ho sakti aur components ke sizes ke jama (170) se zyada nahi. 133.8 is range mein hai, to jawab mantaqi hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(10\sqrt{179}\) km (taqreeban 133.8 km)
Displacement sirf shuru aur aakhri point par depend karta hai.
